request.query:
GOAL: A short note the person keeps open while booking or at the service desk: which service to choose, what to write in a free-text field, what to bring and when they plan to go, all from the facts. Not an email: no request for a reply.

FACTS:
P1: I arrive in Helsinki on 1 December 2026.
P2: I am an EU citizen, moving to Helsinki for work and study.
F1: How to book: Book an appointment for the service "Registration of a foreigner's personal data" via DVV website
F2: Can be done at: Check-In Event
F3: Bring: valid passport or official photo ID card of an EU citizen
F4: Bring: certificate of registration of the right of residence for EU citizens
F5: Bring: proof of work or studies in Finland (employment contract or student status certificate)
P3: I plan to go (DVV) on 2 December 2026.

data.subject: Booking note: DVV registration of a foreigner's personal data

sentences.text: I arrive in Helsinki on 1 December 2026 and I am an EU citizen moving for work and study.
Service to choose: book an appointment for "Registration of a foreigner's personal data" via the DVV website.
This can be done at a Check-In Event.
I plan to go to DVV on 2 December 2026.
To bring: a valid passport or an official photo ID card of an EU citizen.
To bring: the certificate of registration of the right of residence for EU citizens.
To bring: proof of work or studies in Finland, meaning an employment contract or a student status certificate.
